open_possible.frame: The service is assumed to require a central web application.
open_possible.challenged_invariant: Users must interact primarily through that application.
open_possible.residue: Existing agent-to-agent interactions do not fit the application-first frame well.
open_possible.opened_possible: Expose a small agent-facing protocol surface before redesigning the application.
open_possible.booster: Publish one bounded read-only agent endpoint as a reversible experiment.
open_possible.reality_test: Use the endpoint in three real tasks and compare completion quality and friction.

claims.statement: An agent-first surface will become the dominant interface.
Anonymous write access cannot be enabled under the current mandate.
claims.basis: The current mandate authorizes read-only access.
